Name: qlist_sales
SQL:
SELECT cust_list.numw,cust_list.moadon,cust_list.kupa,cust_list.city,cust_list.fname & " " &   cust_list.pname AS qname, orders.odate,orders.yeda As qyeda, orders.qmsgr ,orders.sapakm , orders.sun , val(nz(orders.EmployeeID)) AS qemp, null AS p0,orders.ob_type AS p1, Null AS p2, nz([orders.ob_comp]) AS p3, orders.bprice, orders.ordernum, orders.cn, round(IIf(Val(nz([gdisc]))>0,(Format([bprice]*((Val(Nz([qmaam]))/100)+1),"0.00"))-(Val(nz([gdisc]))*(Format([bprice]*((Val(Nz([qmaam]))/100)+1),"0.00")))/100,(Format([bprice]*((Val(Nz([qmaam]))/100)+1),"0.00"))-(Val(Format(Val(nz([greduce]))/Val(nz([gprice])),"0.000"))*(Format([bprice]*((Val(Nz([qmaam]))/100)+1),"0.00"))))) AS tot,nz([orders.qpart])  As wpart
FROM cust_list INNER JOIN orders ON (cust_list.numw = orders.numw) AND (cust_list.numw = orders.numw)
WHERE (((orders.cn)=False) AND ((nz([qpart]))="מסגרת") AND ((Val(nz([orders.pbprice])))>0) AND ((Val(nz([orders.ordernum])))>0) AND ((Val(nz([orders.gprice])))>0))
ORDER BY orders.odate;
UNION ALL SELECT cust_list.numw,cust_list.moadon,cust_list.kupa,cust_list.city,cust_list.fname & " " &   cust_list.pname AS qname, orders.odate,orders.yeda As qyeda, orders.qmsgr,orders.sapakm2, orders.sun2 , val(nz(orders.EmployeeID)) AS qemp,null AS p0 ,orders.ob_type2 AS p1, Null AS p2, nz([orders.ob_comp2]) AS p3, orders.bprice2, orders.ordernum, orders.cn, round(IIf(Val(nz([gdisc]))>0,(Format([bprice2]*((Val(Nz([qmaam]))/100)+1),"0.00"))-(Val(nz([gdisc]))*(Format([bprice2]*((Val(Nz([qmaam]))/100)+1),"0.00")))/100,(Format([bprice2]*((Val(Nz([qmaam]))/100)+1),"0.00"))-(Val(Format(Val(nz([greduce]))/Val(nz([gprice])),"0.000"))*(Format([bprice2]*((Val(Nz([qmaam]))/100)+1),"0.00"))))) AS tot,nz([orders.qpart2]) As wpart

Name: qlist_total_orders
SQL:
SELECT Trim$([fname])+"  "+Trim$([pname]) AS namew, Trim$(nz([address]))+"  "+Trim$(nz([city])) AS addr, IIf(nz([sel])<>"",[sel],[tel]) AS qtel, cust_list.kamp, qlist_total_ordersp.odate, qlist_total_ordersp.mwdate, qlist_total_ordersp.cn, qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum, qlist_total_ordersp.numw, qlist_total_ordersp.catga, qlist_total_ordersp.totala, qlist_total_ordersp.gf_price, qlist_total_ordersp.gpay, qlist_total_ordersp.gdate, qlist_total_ordersp.ocomp, qlist_total_ordersp.og_type, qlist_total_ordersp.adw, qlist_total_ordersp.sapaka, qlist_total_ordersp.rdate, qlist_total_ordersp.CDate, qlist_total_ordersp.lang, qlist_total_ordersp.multia, qlist_total_ordersp.multib, qlist_total_ordersp.qmsgr, qlist_total_ordersp.yeda, qlist_total_ordersp.swtk, qlist_total_ordersp.color, qlist_total_ordersp.pgpricet, qlist_total_ordersp.pdisct, qlist_total_ordersp.gpricet, qlist_total_ordersp.al2, qlist_total_ordersp.ar2, qlist_total_ordersp.qpart, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_comp, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_type, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_size, qlist_total_ordersp.ocolor, qlist_total_ordersp.bar_size, qlist_total_ordersp.sapakm, qlist_total_ordersp.sun, qlist_total_ordersp.pbprice, qlist_total_ordersp.pdisc, qlist_total_ordersp.bprice, IIf(nz([color])="",Null,xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),2," ")) AS wcolor2, IIf(nz([color])="",Null,xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),1," ")) AS wcolor, xg_GetSubString(nz([qpart]),2," ") AS wpart2, xg_GetSubString(nz([qpart]),2," ") AS wpart
FROM qlist_total_ordersp INNER JOIN cust_list ON qlist_total_ordersp.numw=cust_list.numw
GROUP BY Trim$([fname])+"  "+Trim$([pname]), Trim$(nz([address]))+"  "+Trim$(nz([city])), IIf(nz([sel])<>"",[sel],[tel]), cust_list.kamp, qlist_total_ordersp.odate, qlist_total_ordersp.mwdate, qlist_total_ordersp.cn, qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum, qlist_total_ordersp.numw, qlist_total_ordersp.catga, qlist_total_ordersp.totala, qlist_total_ordersp.gf_price, qlist_total_ordersp.gpay, qlist_total_ordersp.gdate, qlist_total_ordersp.ocomp, qlist_total_ordersp.og_type, qlist_total_ordersp.adw, qlist_total_ordersp.sapaka, qlist_total_ordersp.rdate, qlist_total_ordersp.CDate, qlist_total_ordersp.lang, qlist_total_ordersp.multia, qlist_total_ordersp.multib, qlist_total_ordersp.qmsgr, qlist_total_ordersp.yeda, qlist_total_ordersp.swtk, qlist_total_ordersp.color, qlist_total_ordersp.pgpricet, qlist_total_ordersp.pdisct, qlist_total_ordersp.gpricet, qlist_total_ordersp.al2, qlist_total_ordersp.ar2, qlist_total_ordersp.qpart, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_comp, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_type, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_size, qlist_total_ordersp.ocolor, qlist_total_ordersp.bar_size, qlist_total_ordersp.sapakm, qlist_total_ordersp.sun, qlist_total_ordersp.pbprice, qlist_total_ordersp.pdisc, qlist_total_ordersp.bprice, IIf(nz([color])="",Null,xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),2," ")), IIf(nz([color])="",Null,xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),1," ")), xg_GetSubString(nz([qpart]),2," "), xg_GetSubString(nz([qpart]),2," ")
HAVING (((qlist_total_ordersp.cn)=False) AND ((qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum)>0))
ORDER BY qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum;

Name: qlist_total_orders_a
SQL:
SELECT Trim$([fname])+"  "+Trim$([pname]) AS namew, q_companyn.tel_c, q_companyn.fax__c, q_companyn.pr, Trim$(nz([adress_c]))+" "+Trim$(nz([city_c])) AS caddr, qlist_total_ordersp.odate, qlist_total_ordersp.mwdate, qlist_total_ordersp.cn, qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum, qlist_total_ordersp.catga, qlist_total_ordersp.totala, qlist_total_ordersp.numw, qlist_total_ordersp.gdate, qlist_total_ordersp.rdate, qlist_total_ordersp.CDate, qlist_total_ordersp.qmsgr, qlist_total_ordersp.swtk, qlist_total_ordersp.multia, qlist_total_ordersp.multib, qlist_total_ordersp.lang, qlist_total_ordersp.color, qlist_total_ordersp.al2, qlist_total_ordersp.ar2, xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),1," ") AS wcolor, xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),1," ") AS wcolor2, qlist_total_ordersp.qpart
FROM (qlist_total_ordersp INNER JOIN cust_list ON qlist_total_ordersp.numw = cust_list.numw) INNER JOIN q_companyn ON cust_list.numw = q_companyn.numw
GROUP BY Trim$([fname])+"  "+Trim$([pname]), q_companyn.tel_c, q_companyn.fax__c, q_companyn.pr, Trim$(nz([adress_c]))+" "+Trim$(nz([city_c])), qlist_total_ordersp.odate, qlist_total_ordersp.mwdate, qlist_total_ordersp.cn, qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum, qlist_total_ordersp.catga, qlist_total_ordersp.totala, qlist_total_ordersp.numw, qlist_total_ordersp.gdate, qlist_total_ordersp.rdate, qlist_total_ordersp.CDate, qlist_total_ordersp.qmsgr, qlist_total_ordersp.swtk, qlist_total_ordersp.multia, qlist_total_ordersp.multib, qlist_total_ordersp.lang, qlist_total_ordersp.color, qlist_total_ordersp.al2, qlist_total_ordersp.ar2, xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),1," "), xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),1," "), qlist_total_ordersp.qpart
HAVING (((qlist_total_ordersp.cn)=False) AND ((qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum)>0) AND ((qlist_total_ordersp.color) Is Not Null))
ORDER BY qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum;

Name: qlist_total_orders_frm
SQL:
SELECT orders.*, Trim$([fname])+"  "+Trim$([pname]) & " " & IIf(nz([cust_list]![sel])<>"",[cust_list]![sel],nz([cust_list]![tel])) AS namew, Trim$([pname])+"  "+Trim$([fname]) AS prname, [cust_list]![sel] AS qtel, Trim$([pname]) AS prati, cust_list.moadon, orders.odate AS f1, orders.mwdate AS f2, orders.CDate AS f3, xg_GetSubString(nz(IIf(nz([mwdate])<>"",nz(DLookUp("[checkname]","checks","[numw] = " & [orders]![numw] & " and [chdate]=" & "#" & NZ([mwdate]) & "#")),nz(DLookUp("[checkname]","checks","[numw] = " & [orders]![numw] & " and [chdate]=" & "#" & NZ([odate]) & "#")))),1," ") AS f4, cust_list.pname AS f5p, cust_list.fname AS f5f, nz([FirstName]) AS f6, orders.rdate AS f7, IIf(nz([orders]![cdate])<>"",DateAdd("d",90,[orders]![cdate]),Null) AS f8, IIf(nz([orders]![cdate])<>"",DateAdd("d",14,[orders]![cdate]),Null) AS f9, Val(nz([cadsh])) AS f10, Val(nz([cmsgr])) AS f11, "15-1-" & nz([cust_list]![number]) AS f12
FROM cust_list INNER JOIN ((tb_qnum INNER JOIN orders ON tb_qnum.qnum=orders.ordernum) LEFT JOIN employees ON orders.EmployeeID=employees.EmployeeID) ON cust_list.numw=orders.numw;

SQL:
SELECT Trim$([fname])+"  "+Trim$([pname]) AS namew, q_companyn.pr, q_companyn.tel_c, q_companyn.fax__c, Trim$(nz([adress_c]))+" "+Trim$(nz([city_c])) AS caddr, qlist_total_ordersp.odate, qlist_total_ordersp.mwdate, qlist_total_ordersp.cn, qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum, qlist_total_ordersp.catga, qlist_total_ordersp.totala, qlist_total_ordersp.numw, qlist_total_ordersp.gdate, qlist_total_ordersp.rdate, qlist_total_ordersp.CDate, qlist_total_ordersp.qmsgr, qlist_total_ordersp.swtk, qlist_total_ordersp.multia, qlist_total_ordersp.multib, qlist_total_ordersp.lang, qlist_total_ordersp.qpart, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_comp, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_type, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_size, qlist_total_ordersp.ocolor, qlist_total_ordersp.bar_size, qlist_total_ordersp.sapakm, qlist_total_ordersp.sun, xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),1," ") AS wcolor, qlist_total_ordersp.color, xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),1," ") AS wcolor2, qlist_total_ordersp.qpart
FROM (qlist_total_ordersp INNER JOIN cust_list ON qlist_total_ordersp.numw = cust_list.numw) INNER JOIN q_companyn ON cust_list.numw = q_companyn.numw
GROUP BY Trim$([fname])+"  "+Trim$([pname]), q_companyn.pr, q_companyn.tel_c, q_companyn.fax__c, Trim$(nz([adress_c]))+" "+Trim$(nz([city_c])), qlist_total_ordersp.odate, qlist_total_ordersp.mwdate, qlist_total_ordersp.cn, qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum, qlist_total_ordersp.catga, qlist_total_ordersp.totala, qlist_total_ordersp.numw, qlist_total_ordersp.gdate, qlist_total_ordersp.rdate, qlist_total_ordersp.CDate, qlist_total_ordersp.qmsgr, qlist_total_ordersp.swtk, qlist_total_ordersp.multia, qlist_total_ordersp.multib, qlist_total_ordersp.lang, qlist_total_ordersp.qpart, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_comp, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_type, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_size, qlist_total_ordersp.ocolor, qlist_total_ordersp.bar_size, qlist_total_ordersp.sapakm, qlist_total_ordersp.sun, xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),1," "), qlist_total_ordersp.color, xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),1," "), qlist_total_ordersp.qpart
HAVING (((qlist_total_ordersp.cn)=False) AND ((qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum)>0) AND ((qlist_total_ordersp.qpart) Is Not Null))
ORDER BY qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum;

Name: qlist_total_orders_multi
SQL:

FROM (qlist_total_ordersp INNER JOIN cust_list ON qlist_total_ordersp.numw = cust_list.numw) INNER JOIN qlist_total_orders_multip ON (qlist_total_ordersp.numw = qlist_total_orders_multip.numw) AND (qlist_total_ordersp.odate = qlist_total_orders_multip.dt)
GROUP BY Trim$([fname])+"  "+Trim$([pname]), Trim$(nz([address]))+"  "+Trim$(nz([city])), IIf(nz([sel])<>"",[sel],[tel]), cust_list.kamp, qlist_total_ordersp.odate, qlist_total_ordersp.mwdate, qlist_total_ordersp.cn, qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum, qlist_total_ordersp.numw, qlist_total_ordersp.catga, qlist_total_ordersp.totala, qlist_total_ordersp.gf_price, qlist_total_ordersp.gpay, qlist_total_ordersp.gdate, qlist_total_ordersp.ocomp, qlist_total_ordersp.og_type, qlist_total_ordersp.adw, qlist_total_ordersp.sapaka, qlist_total_ordersp.rdate, qlist_total_ordersp.CDate, qlist_total_ordersp.lang, qlist_total_ordersp.multia, qlist_total_ordersp.multib, qlist_total_ordersp.qmsgr, qlist_total_ordersp.yeda, qlist_total_ordersp.swtk, qlist_total_ordersp.color, qlist_total_ordersp.pgpricet, qlist_total_ordersp.pdisct, qlist_total_ordersp.gpricet, qlist_total_ordersp.al2, qlist_total_ordersp.ar2, qlist_total_ordersp.qpart, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_comp, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_type, qlist_total_ordersp.ob_size, qlist_total_ordersp.ocolor, qlist_total_ordersp.bar_size, qlist_total_ordersp.sapakm, qlist_total_ordersp.sun, qlist_total_ordersp.pbprice, qlist_total_ordersp.pdisc, qlist_total_ordersp.bprice, IIf(nz([color])="",Null,xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),2," ")), IIf(nz([color])="",Null,xg_GetSubString(nz([color]),1," ")), xg_GetSubString(nz([qpart]),2," "), xg_GetSubString(nz([qpart]),2," ")
HAVING (((qlist_total_ordersp.cn)=False) AND ((qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum)>0))
ORDER BY qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum;

Name: qlist_total_orders_multip
SQL:
SELECT qlist_total_ordersp.numw, Max(qlist_total_ordersp.odate) AS dt, qlist_total_ordersp.cn
FROM qlist_total_ordersp INNER JOIN cust_list ON qlist_total_ordersp.numw=cust_list.numw
WHERE (((qlist_total_ordersp.catga)="מולטיפוקל") AND ((qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum)>0)) OR (((qlist_total_ordersp.ordernum)>0) AND ((qlist_total_ordersp.color)="משקפיים מולטיפוקל"))
GROUP BY qlist_total_ordersp.numw, qlist_total_ordersp.cn
HAVING (((qlist_total_ordersp.cn)=False Or (qlist_total_ordersp.cn)=False))
ORDER BY qlist_total_ordersp.numw, Max(qlist_total_ordersp.odate);
